answer_1.quote: Single-document extractive summarization forms summary by copying and concatenating the most important spans (usually sentences) in a document.
answer_1.outputs: extractive summaries by selecting sentences from the source document

answer_2.quote: ROUGE is the standard metric for evaluating the quality of summaries.

answer_4.quote: we design an experiment based on a ranking method to evaluate the performance of DifferSum by humans.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are requested to rank these summaries (ties allowed) by taking informativeness (Can the summary capture the important information from the document) and fluency (Is the summary grammatical) into account.
